answer: Willow commit-reveal bond: each identity locks a 60-credit bond and posts a willow-sealed commitment on the public ledge, hiding its plan. At reveal a raven courier carries the key; the plan must match the commitment or the bond burns. Filings 42+5(k-1): forging 1,000 costs 2,539,500 plus 60,000 locked, dwarfing the 40,000 pool. A copied-commitment ring fails: identical willow seals burn both bonds. One honest filing costs 42, bond intact.
